basic_details.job_title: IIT Gandhinagar Junior Research Fellow (Mechanical) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Mechanical department of the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar has invited applications for 1 temporary Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post on the project "Development of Scalable Nanostructured Surfaces as PFAS-Free Alternatives", under Principal Investigator Soumyadip Sett. The appointment is for 3 months. Consolidated pay including HRA is Rs. 31,000 per month for candidates with a national-level exam qualification such as CSIR-UGC NET GATE, and Rs. 23,213 per month for those without. The essential qualification is B.Tech/B.E. or M.Sc. in the disciplines listed below. Apply throug

qualification.details: B.Tech/B.E. in Chemical/Materials/Bio/Mechanical Engineering or related fields, OR M.Sc. in Physics/Chemistry/Biology or other relevant allied disciplines. Minimum 60% or equivalent grade from graduation onwards, and 55% or equivalent grade in class 10th and 12th.

how_to_apply: The notice gives the application link http://recruitment.iitgn.ac.in/projectstaff/ and sets 30.11.2026 as the last date of application submission. The notice names no documents to attach. The contact email printed in the notice is [email protected].
important_instructions: Merely meeting the minimum eligibility criteria will not guarantee shortlisting and/or appointment. A higher cutoff level may be used. The Institute reserves all rights not to call an applicant for a selection test, or not to fill the position through this round of selection process, without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: About IIT Gandhinagar
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Research & Development Office of the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar. It advertises a temporary project position in the Mechanical department, with Soumyadip Sett as Principal Investigator (PI).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives one post, Junior Research Fellow (JRF), with 1 position. B.Tech/B.E. in Chemical/Materials/Bio/Mechanical Engineering or related fields, OR M.Sc. in Physics/Chemistry/Biology or other relevant allied disciplines. Minimum 60% or equivalent grade from graduation onwards, and 55% or equivalent grade in class 10th and 12th. Strong foundation in Chemistry, Surface Science, Polymer Science, or Bioengineering. Experience in materials characterization techniques (SEM, XRD, FTIR, contact angle, profilometry, thermal analysis, etc.). Skills in experimental design and data analysis. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay is stated to include HRA, and the separate House Rent Allowance entry reads "NA". The duration of appointment is 3 months. The notice calls the post a temporary position.

rows.candidate_category: Requisite educational qualifications and qualified through national-level examinations such as CSIR-UGC NET GATE, or other equivalent examinations
Requisite educational qualifications but no national level exam qualification

content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: Develop bioinspired non-PFAS hydrophobic coatings for biomedical applications. Design, synthesize, and optimize functional coating formulations using environmentally friendly materials and scalable fabrication approaches. Evaluate coating performance in terms of water repellency, antibacterial activity, anti-biofouling properties, corrosion resistance, and durability under relevant operating conditions.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Gandhinagar Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: The notice gives the application link http://recruitment.iitgn.ac.in/projectstaff/ and sets 30.11.2026 as the last date of application submission. The notice names no documents to attach. The contact email printed in the notice is [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Merely meeting the minimum eligibility criteria will not guarantee shortlisting and/or appointment. A higher cutoff level may be used. The Institute reserves all rights not to call an applicant for a selection test, or not to fill the position through this round of selection process, without assigning any reason.
